#!/bin/bash

# Output file
OUTPUT="/home/user/low_memory_report.txt"

# Temporary file for collecting results
TEMP_FILE=$(mktemp)

# Process each host file
for hostfile in /home/user/memstats/host*.txt; do
    hostname=$(basename "$hostfile" .txt)
    
    # Extract MemTotal and MemAvailable, handling missing values
    mem_total=$(grep -E '^MemTotal:' "$hostfile" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
    mem_available=$(grep -E '^MemAvailable:' "$hostfile" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
    
    # Skip if either value is missing or empty
    if [[ -z "$mem_total" ]] || [[ -z "$mem_available" ]]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Calculate percentage available (using bc for floating point)
    percentage=$(echo "scale=2; ($mem_available * 100) / $mem_total" | bc)
    
    # Check if less than 20%
    is_low=$(echo "$percentage < 20" | bc)
    
    if [[ $is_low -eq 1 ]]; then
        # Store for sorting: percentage, hostname, percentage (for output)
        echo "$percentage	$hostname	$percentage" >> "$TEMP_FILE"
    fi
done

# Sort by percentage (ascending = worst first) and output hostname + percentage
if [[ -f "$TEMP_FILE" ]] && [[ -s "$TEMP_FILE" ]]; then
    sort -n "$TEMP_FILE" | awk -F'\t' '{print $2 "\t" $3}' > "$OUTPUT"
else
    # Create empty file if no hosts meet criteria
    touch "$OUTPUT"
fi

# Cleanup
rm -f "$TEMP_FILE"
EOF

cat > process_memory.sh << 'EOF'
#!/bin/bash

# Output file
OUTPUT="/home/user/low_memory_report.txt"

# Temporary file for collecting results
TEMP_FILE=$(mktemp)

# Process each host file
for hostfile in /home/user/memstats/host*.txt; do
    hostname=$(basename "$hostfile" .txt)
    
    # Extract MemTotal and MemAvailable, handling missing values
    mem_total=$(grep -E '^MemTotal:' "$hostfile" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
    mem_available=$(grep -E '^MemAvailable:' "$hostfile" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}')
    
    # Skip if either value is missing or empty
    if [[ -z "$mem_total" ]] || [[ -z "$mem_available" ]]; then
        continue
    fi
    
    # Calculate percentage available and check if less than 20% using awk
    awk -v total="$mem_total" -v avail="$mem_available" -v host="$hostname" '
    BEGIN {
        if (total > 0) {
            percentage = (avail * 100) / total
            if (percentage < 20) {
                printf "%.2f\t%s\t%.2f\n", percentage, host, percentage
            }
        }
    }' >> "$TEMP_FILE"
done

# Sort by percentage (ascending = worst first) and output hostname + percentage
if [[ -f "$TEMP_FILE" ]] && [[ -s "$TEMP_FILE" ]]; then
    sort -n "$TEMP_FILE" | awk -F'\t' '{print $2 "\t" $3}' > "$OUTPUT"
else
    # Create empty file if no hosts meet criteria
    touch "$OUTPUT"
fi

# Cleanup
rm -f "$TEMP_FILE"
EOF
